title: Why you get brain freeze
beats: He snuck a slushie into class and waited till the teacher turned around.
Then he chugged half of it, and his head exploded so hard he screamed.
You see, your brain panics at the cold and sets off every alarm in your head.
And when it finally stopped, the whole class was staring at him in silence.
hook: 0-2s: him at his desk, slushie hidden under the desk / behind his textbook, eyes locked on the teacher's back, waiting

staging.sneak: teacher writing on the board; he slides the cup out, slow, eyes on her; she turns around: he freezes, cup down; she turns back to the board
staging.chug: he chugs, cheeks hollow, eyes wide... head explodes: grabs his head and SCREAMS (mouth wide, whole body arched)
staging.brain_hq: HQ iced over, a block of ice smashes through the ceiling (the cold), little him in a parka panics and slams EVERY alarm button, sirens + red lights everywhere (funny, not a science diagram)
staging.payoff: pain fades, he exhales, opens his eyes... dead silence. The whole class + the teacher turned round staring at him. He slowly lowers the cup. Hold on the stares.

recording_note: take A (21:38 first file) + 1.6 s silence added at the end for the stares (Xavier 2026-11-14)
